content.rendered: Middleton Science and Innovation Night is Friday, April 13th, 6:00-7:30 in the Middleton Cafeteria.   All students, even those who will not be participating are encouraged to attend.  Come and try out all of our hands -on projects and experiments.  Students will have the opportunity to experiment with building “roller coasters” out of pool noodles, develop catapults, create spaghetti towers, cheer for battling Sumobots, explore Lego Robotics and more!  You will not want to miss this fun evening.  Free admission.
